findings.finding: Legacy live-transient guard initially had no captured/source-usable lower bound; independent input services also needed the aggregate admitted-evidence lower bound before solving.
findings.remediation: Initialize from max(captured_at, FPL usable_at); pre-solve check raises the existing monotone floor to current_state.decision_information_at.

findings.finding: Generic Confidence label could present Stage-7 minutes confidence as overall decision confidence.
Final CLI clock read and missing publication receipt could escape the typed publication boundary.
findings.remediation: Both CLIs use checked_report; malformed service evidence and clock failures produce sanitized typed errors.

findings.finding: Final clock was sampled before receipt/report binding validation; crossing the deadline during validation still returned an actionable report. Receipt sealing had the analogous ordering.
findings.remediation: Read the final clock after all binding validation; check again after receipt sealing before bind returns.

findings.finding: Receipt checked_at retained the pre-sealing sample t10 while the service observed t11 after sealing; a final CLI clock t10.5 could therefore erase the service high-water mark.
findings.original_failure_evidence: Independently reproduced by /root/accel_governance_audit; see retained INDEPENDENT-CROSS-STREAM-FINDING-01 evidence.
findings.remediation: Both frozen transient service results carry publication_not_before from the guard's final observed timestamp. The final boundary validates receipt.checked_at <= floor < deadline and checks the publication clock against that floor.
